newsitem.title: UK: BURTON NAMES NIGEL HALL FINANCE DIRECTOR.
newsitem.headline: BURTON NAMES NIGEL HALL FINANCE DIRECTOR.

text.p: British retailer Burton Group Plc said on Thursday Nigel Hall would become finance director of the group on November 15.
Hall will replace Andrew Higginson who will leave on that date to become finance director of Tesco Plc.
The group said in a statement that Hall had been appointed to the board with immediate effect and between now and November would continue in his responsibility as director of the demerger process.

It added that following the demerger of its profitable department store business Debenhams -- expected early next year -- Hall would continue as finance director of the re-named Burton Group which will operate the group's multiples businesses.
